check.title: Accessibility check
check.intro: We check your page as you work. Nothing here stops you from saving, but fixing it helps every student.

checkWhy.alt: Screen reader users hear the description instead of seeing the picture.
checkWhy.contrast: Low-contrast text is hard to read, especially on phones outdoors or for students with low vision.
checkWhy.heading: Headings let students (and screen readers) jump around the page quickly.
checkWhy.link: Link text should say where the link goes, so it makes sense on its own.
checkWhy.empty: Empty items show up as blank buttons or stray bullets, which is confusing.
checkWhy.course: Links to places in “this course” are filled in when the page is saved to the course.
checkWhy.default: Small fixes like this make the page easier for every student to use.
